Page 26 Cont.
Feb. 16 John Marsland - 66 - cancer of throat - already in dying condition - had misunderstanding with wife about five years ago and refuses to make up - She presbiterian - he nothing .... Enrolled To-day by Catholic neighbor 2.00
Page 27
Feb. 22 Mrs. Marie L. Dufrin - 38 - threatening condition of chin and jaw - has started again after 3 yrs. and is worse than before 2nd op- eration. Enrolls To-night .... 2.00
Delphine Wisniewski - 13 - very backward in learning; in fact though big enough to be 16, has seemingly to mind of a child of six yrs. Enrolled perpetually several years back and again To-day.
24 Wm Bucher - 42 - in Ford Hosp'l bad nervous break .... Enrolled Today - perpt.
Geralding Cullen - 31 - Epileptic for 17 yrs; Of late has been quite unable to speak and helpless otherwise though beautifully re- signed - Enrolls again (2.)
27 Robert Singer - 21 - across seas - Mother anxious to hear - no word in six weeks.
Mary M. O'Donahue - 21 - nerve-break.
1945, March
Page 28
Mar. 1st Mrs. Lou Anna Levine - 23 - hand-Eczema as long as she remembers. A "Nazarine" with Jewish husband who believes in God without prac- ticing any faith or going to Church. Objects to his little boy be- ing taught religion.
1st James Beattie - 55 - anxious lest brain tumor force operation - has severe headaches. Enrolls 5.00.
in 5 Mary Dutts - 54 - intestinal cancer . operation To-morrow Jacqueline Izzo - 8 - of St. Mary Hosp. - Saginaw, Mich. since last July from serious burn.
Judith Wall - 2 - asthma & bronchitis.
Julia Lyons - 66 - abdominal and gall-trouble.
